method: Player-level median 14-d stat-profile vector (per-100, era-z-scored) from assets/vectors.json; Ward agglomerative clustering on 2,426 players; k=5 families and k=22 archetypes cut from one dendrogram (silhouette-guided, anchor-validated). Archetype labels derived from cluster stat signatures (percentiles vs all players), not vibes. Magic Johnson absent: career predates the 1996-97 dataset start.

families.label: Role Wings & Forwards
families.description: Wings and forwards in supporting roles — defenders, spot shooters and journeymen.

children.label: Rotation Wings
children.description: League-average wings who fill minutes without a signature skill.

children.label: Blue-Collar Backup Bigs
children.description: Physical backup bigs who crash the offensive glass (71st percentile OREB) and never shoot threes.

children.label: Deep-Bench Bigs
children.description: End-of-roster bigs; replacement level across the board (8th percentile plus-minus).

children.label: Journeyman Wings
children.description: Low-usage veteran wings — classic 10th-man types.

children.label: 3&D Wings
children.description: Defensive stoppers who hit open threes (87th percentile steals, 88th percentile plus-minus) on low usage.

children.label: Fringe Forwards
children.description: Fringe forwards who take threes but make almost none (9th percentile 3P%).

children.label: Defensive Pests
children.description: Perimeter ball-hawks (95th percentile steals) who can't shoot (5th percentile 3P%).

families.label: Traditional Bigs
families.description: Paint-bound centers — rim protection, rebounding and dunks, no jump shot.

children.label: Rim Runners & Protectors
children.description: Lob threats and paint erasers (93rd OREB, 96th FG%, 92nd blocks) who never leave the paint. Home of Gobert and Mutombo.

children.label: Defensive Anchor Centers
children.description: Rim-protecting centers (93rd percentile blocks) with essentially no offensive role.

children.label: Rebound & Defense Specialists
children.description: Elite glass-eaters (90th percentile OREB) who defend and do little else. Home of Rodman and Wallace.

children.label: Deep-Bench Rim Protectors
children.description: Shot-blockers (93rd percentile blocks) who barely play (5th percentile scoring).

families.label: Scoring Bigs
families.description: Bigs who score — post hubs, skilled veteran forwards and superstar two-way anchors.

children.label: Rotation Bigs
children.description: Dependable rotation bigs — average starters to good backups, solid on the glass.

children.label: Versatile Veteran Bigs
children.description: Skilled veteran bigs and combo forwards who score, rebound and stretch the floor.

children.label: Dominant Two-Way Stars
children.description: Superstar forwards and centers who score (94th percentile PTS), draw fouls (95th FTA) and own the glass (93rd DREB).

families.label: Shooters & Wings
families.description: Perimeter players — sharpshooters, high-volume scorers and shot creators.

children.label: Spot-Up Shooters
children.description: Catch-and-shoot specialists (85th percentile 3PA) on modest usage.

children.label: Elite Point Guards
children.description: Pass-first floor generals (90th percentile assists) who also shoot it. Home of Nash, Stockton and Paul.

children.label: Sharpshooters
children.description: Elite movement and spot-up shooters (91st percentile 3PA, 88th 3P%). Home of Allen, Miller and Thompson.

children.label: High-Volume Star Scorers
children.description: Superstar shot creators (97th percentile scoring, 96th shot volume) who carry offenses. Home of Jordan, Bryant, Curry and Lillard.

families.label: Ball-Handlers
families.description: Primary ball-handlers — point guards and combo guards, from floor generals to deep reserves.

children.label: Steady Backup Point Guards
children.description: Low-mistake backup PGs (90th percentile assists) who take care of the ball.

children.label: Pass-First Defenders
children.description: Defensive playmakers (93rd assists, 92nd steals) — including Draymond Green as a point forward.

children.label: Erratic Combo Guards
children.description: Score-first guards undone by turnovers (93rd percentile TOV) and bricklaying (15th percentile FG%).

children.label: Deep-Bench Ball-Handlers
children.description: Third-string guards who turn it over (95th percentile TOV).
